TcDataset.description: Mei0WIMESRepresentation is a dataset type used to hold the Work Instruction documents for the dispatcher request in the Manufacturing Execution System Integration.The work instructions are included as attachments when releasing the data to the MES and can be made available for viewing in the MES.

TcForm.description: The business object Mei0RelUpdToMesInfo is a Form object. Place holder to tell MES the nature of delta package being exported.This refers to the additional information related to the release. When releasing an execution plan to the MES, a full release is performed first time and then release only delta changes as updates based on their release status, are sent to the Manufacturing Execution System (MES).

TcStandardType.description: Mei0ExecutionPlan is used to configure an execution Bill of Process to Manufacturing Execution System based on Collaboration Context object.

The business object Mei0ProductionPlan is used to configure a Bill of Process to production system. This configuration is based on Collaboration Context object.Production plan is a dedicated collaboration context of type production plan. The production plan consists of a process structure context containing bill of process. It is the amount of work sent to the production system as package.

The business object Mei0RelUpdToMesInfoRel represents the relation to attach the delta information form of type Mei0RelUpdToMesInfo to the request object of the Application Interface.This contains the additional release related information which is not present in the request object plmxml.
Form Storage object for "Mei0RelUpdToMesInfo" business object

Mei0StructureContextRel is used for attaching VisStructureContext to Request Object.Request Object is primaryVisStructureContext is secondary with 1:1 cardinality. VisStructureContext holds the bill of process structure along with configuration.

Mei0WIMESRepresentationRel represents the relationship between operation/step and work instruction document dataset. Textual work instructions in Teamcenter can be associated with an operation/ step in the execution plan.The work instructions are included as attachments when releasing the data to the MES and can be made available for viewing in the MES.

OperationTemplate.description:
This service returns the execution status of Work Orders to be queried from the MES system.
Work Order is the execution order created based on Configuration Specific Execution Plan(Mei0ExecutionPlan) for a specific release date which is exported to MES system.

Mei0ExecutionPlan is the Collaboration Context object which is referred in below two ways based on the configuration:
150% Execution Plan(Master) - Bill of Process with no effectivity or variability configuration applied.
100% Execution Plan(Work Order) - 150% execution plan configured for specific unit and date(or variants).

Mei0ExecutionPlan object is identified as Work Order based on the "Order ID" property set on Mei0ExecutionPlan.
OperationTemplate.name: Mei0::Soa::MESInteg::Release::findWorkOrderStatusProps
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
The response contains map where the key is Mei0ExecutionPlan(Work Order) UID and value is map of execution status properties and their corresponding values from MES system.
The following partial errors may be returned:
286564 : The Execution Plan is not configured as Work Order.
325009 : MES system service error.
325008 : MES system connection error.

OperationParameter.description: A list of Mei0ExecutionPlan objects for which the execution status properties needs to be found from the MES system.
OperationParameter.name: orderCCs

Operation.description:
This service returns the execution status of Work Orders to be queried from the MES system.
Work Order is the execution order created based on Configuration Specific Execution Plan(Mei0ExecutionPlan) for a specific release date which is exported to MES system.

Mei0ExecutionPlan is the Collaboration Context object which is referred in below two ways based on the configuration:
150% Execution Plan(Master) - Bill of Process with no effectivity or variability configuration applied.
100% Execution Plan(Work Order) - 150% execution plan configured for specific unit and date(or variants).

Mei0ExecutionPlan object is identified as Work Order based on the "Order ID" property set on Mei0ExecutionPlan.
Operation.name: findWorkOrderStatusProps
Operation.returnDescription:
The response contains map where the key is Mei0ExecutionPlan(Work Order) UID and value is map of execution status properties and their corresponding values from MES system.
The following partial errors may be returned:
286564 : The Execution Plan is not configured as Work Order.
325009 : MES system service error.
325008 : MES system connection error.
Operation.useCase:
User opens Mei0ExecutionPlan object in Manufacturing Process Planner(MPP), selects root line from the Bill Of Process (BOP) structure and performs “Find Impacted Baselines” action. A list of Work Orders is populated in the Find Impacted Baselines dialogue.
User selects the work orders for which the execution status properties needs to be found from the MES system and do execute action on the button click in the dialogue. The status properties are displayed in the same dialogue against the selected work orders.
Based on the status information of running Work Orders, user can choose which Work Order needs to be updated.
